plain: To spoil or stain, as a person's good name

webster.text: To soil; to dirt; to spot; to tarnish.

example.quote: Chairman, it is extremely disagreeable to me to enter into this discussion, as it is foreign to the object of our deliberations here, and may, in the opinion of some, tend to sully the reputation of our public councils.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 13, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
